Class ImageLoader

java.lang.Object
jmt.framework.gui.image.ImageLoader
Direct Known Subclasses:
ImageLoaderImpl
public abstract class ImageLoader extends Object

Name: ImageLoader

Description: A class used to load images. Each subclass must implement the getImageURL method to retrieve URL of resource to be loaded. This class holds a cache of loaded images. Cache size can be adjusted using the maxCache field.

Date: 23/gen/07 Time: 15:09:14

    • mergeIcons

      protected ImageIcon mergeIcons(ImageIcon background, ImageIcon overlay, Point cropMin, Point cropMax, Point move)
      Merge two icons together. Output icon dimension is the same as background one.
      Parameters:
      background - background icon
      overlay - overlay icon, needs to be transparent (will be moved and cropped)
      cropMin - minimum crop point for overlay icon (0,0 for no crop)
      cropMax - maximum crop point for overlay icon (width and height for no crop)
      move - upper left corner where cropped overlay image should be positioned on background image
      Returns:
      merged icon
